255b0c0e06.q: What services should be included in an in-office dental membership plan design?
255b0c0e06.a: The ideal plan should include two regular cleanings per year with accompanying exams and x-rays. Some offices add value-added services like fluoride, sealants, or annual take-home whitening. The plan typically also provides a percentage discount on any other service in the practice. The key advantage is locking patients into the practice on a regular recurring basis for routine care.
